preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**4 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list has the same length as the input array.

postconditions.expression: all((x in arr and arr.count(x) < arr.count(y)) or x == -1 for x, y in zip(return_value, arr))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is either -1 or an element from the input array that has a greater frequency than the corresponding element in the input array.
